newsitem.title: USA: PRESS DIGEST - Washington Post business - April 9.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Washington Post business - April 9.

text.p: The Washington Post carried the following stories on the front page of its business section on Wednesday.
WASHINGTON - Blacks and Hispanics face substantial discrimination when they try to buy a home in the Washington area, according to a newly released survey.

WASHINGTON - The unveiling of Lockheed Martin Corp's first F-22 in a Georgia aircraft hangar will be an upbeat affair, but ceremonial bunting and laser light shows cannot conceal the company's unease about the fighter jet's cost and necessity.

WASHINGTON - Two months after the world's major economic powers suggested they wanted to halt the dollar's ascent on foreign exchange markets, the dollar has risen this week to new highs against both the yen and the mark.
WASHINGTON - Norfolk Southern Corp and CSX Corp have agreed on a plan to split Conrail Inc between them.
